evidence.title: README.md
evidence.locator: What is this; More features; Quick start; FAQ; Roadmap; Tech stack; Security
evidence.finding: Free Electron app on three desktop OSes owns lead/teammate orchestration, tasks, comments, messaging, review diffs, optional worktrees and token/cost analytics. Runtime subscriptions/API keys are reused. Cloud 24/7 and account switching are roadmap items, not current cloud execution.

evidence.title: LICENSE
evidence.locator: GNU Affero General Public License Version 3 and application notice
evidence.finding: Repository application license is AGPL-3.0. The CLA does not replace that public license.

evidence.title: src/main/services/schedule/SchedulerService.ts
evidence.locator: SchedulerService timer, due-run admission and executor call
evidence.finding: Pinned scheduler implementation uses due-run checks and nextRunAt to dispatch persisted schedules through the executor. Renderer schedule components expose configuration, linking it to an accessible product feature.

evidence.title: src/main/services/schedule/ScheduledTaskExecutor.ts
evidence.finding: Pinned scheduled executor resolves runtime binary, spawns with prompt, tracks process, persists output/result and offers cancellation. Supported Claude launch accepts max-budget-usd.

evidence.title: v2.18.6
evidence.finding: v2.18.6 was published 2026-11-05. Release notes describe the scoped changes; this is not a hands-on check.

evidence.title: Agent Teams settings: Privacy telemetry toggle
evidence.locator: src/renderer/components/settings/sections/GeneralSection.tsx lines 623-637; label text in src/features/localization/renderer/locales/en/settings.json lines 321-322, commit 63166ea
evidence.finding: Settings, General, Privacy shows a Send anonymous telemetry toggle (crash, performance and product usage data) bound to general.telemetryEnabled whenever telemetry is built in. The same toggle is present at release tag v2.18.6.

evidence.title: Agent Teams main-process telemetry gate
evidence.locator: src/main/sentry.ts lines 85-114 (telemetryAllowed, syncTelemetryFlag, filterSentryEventForTelemetry); default in src/main/services/infrastructure/ConfigManager.ts line 403, commit 63166ea
evidence.finding: The persisted telemetryEnabled flag is read before Sentry starts; turning it off shuts Sentry down and drops events. The default configuration sets telemetryEnabled to true, so telemetry is on until the user disables it.

evidence.title: Agent Teams README FAQ: parallel teams
evidence.locator: README.md line 389 (FAQ on running multiple teams), commit 63166ea
evidence.finding: Multiple teams can run in one or several projects at once; git worktree isolation can be enabled for selected teammates at launch, and branch or merge rules are left to the provisioning prompt.

evidence.title: Agent Teams src/main/standalone.ts
evidence.locator: Standalone entry and HttpServer static renderer; README limited standalone dashboard; electron-builder targets; mcp-server/package.json bin and src/index.ts
evidence.finding: The shipped limited standalone mode serves the renderer and API without Electron; full web runtime parity remains in development. Release targets build desktop clients, with no native iOS/Android target. The product-owned agent-teams-mcp executable starts its MCP command-line server.

evidence.title: Agent Teams src/features/runtime-provider-management/main/infrastructure/cli-companion/definitions/CursorAgentCompanionDefinition.ts
evidence.locator: CursorAgent companion definition; src/main/services/team/opencode/bridge/CursorAgentAttributionRecords.ts and CursorAgentProcessCleanup.ts; teamProvider.ts; native runtime launch implementations; bounded adapter search
evidence.finding: Cursor companion installation/authentication and process-attribution paths invoke the cursor-agent coding CLI through the OpenCode bridge. The Gemini team provider is a model/auth backend of the Claude runtime, not a separate Gemini CLI executable. The scoped provider/runtime tables and launch adapters have no Pi, Grok CLI, Aider or Antigravity coding-harness adapter; SuperGrok is model/provider access.

evidence.title: Agent Teams src/main/services/team/TeamProvisioningService.ts
evidence.locator: spawnCli and provisioning delegate wiring; scoped launch configuration and worktree paths; README Roadmap remote execution and cloud teams
evidence.finding: The desktop launches local agent processes through spawnCli and optional worktree provisioning. The complete provisioning/runtime option model has no container or VM isolation backend. Remote team execution over SSH and autonomous cloud teams are unchecked roadmap work.

evidence.title: Agent Teams src/main/services/infrastructure/HttpServer.ts
evidence.locator: HttpServer registration and auth/membership search; standalone.ts local context; src/features/organizations models; controller messages human user identity
evidence.finding: The scoped application serves local OS-account data and a trusted-network HTTP dashboard. HTTP admission has CORS and path/context validation but no human membership, workspace-role or enterprise SSO system. Organization and teammate roles model AI-agent organization, not human user permissions.

evidence.title: Agent Teams mcp-server/src/index.ts
evidence.locator: resolveStartOptions, main and isEntrypoint; mcp-server/package.json bin; agent-teams-controller/src/index.js exports; root package.json standalone launcher; bounded package-bin/process.argv/commander/yargs/parseArgs search across product entry points.
evidence.finding: The only published command executable starts an MCP protocol server with transport/host/port options. The controller package exports a JavaScript library; the standalone command launches the browser renderer. No product-owned user/session CLI command parser or verbs are implemented in the scoped entry points. Underlying coding-agent CLIs are separate.

evidence.title: Agent Teams src/main/services/team/TeamWorktreeGitService.ts
evidence.locator: getStatus, initializeRepository and createInitialCommit; TeamMemberWorktreeManager ensureMemberWorktree/createWorktree; GitStatusService; main HTTP/IPC routes and MCP tools; bounded gh pr/pull_request/pull request/createPullRequest/create_pr/open_pr/merge_pull source search.
evidence.finding: Product Git services inspect repositories, create an initial local commit and provision teammate worktrees. The scoped HTTP/IPC/MCP operations have no product-owned pull-request creation, review-comment management, PR status store or forge merge path. The inbox relay only tells agents to verify PR claims through an available repository/GitHub tool; that is an agent instruction rather than a product PR workflow.
